questions.q:

also.text: **Art. 171**: Council strength at most **one-third** of the Assembly and at least **40**. Members: 1/3 elected by local bodies, 1/12 by graduates, 1/12 by teachers, 1/3 by MLAs, 1/6 nominated by the Governor.
